purpose: Honest attempt to freeze the 8 design parameters required for prototype readiness. Each parameter is FROZEN (with evidence) or BLOCKED (with what biology/chemistry work is needed).
constitutional_basis: Articles XXV (unknown must remain unknown), XXVII (no threshold invention), XXVIII (no silent semantic promotion). The enzyme cocktail is a HYPOTHESIS and cannot be frozen without biological/chemical feasibility work.
summary: 4 of 8 parameters FROZEN (engineering parameters that don't depend on biology). 4 of 8 BLOCKED on biological/chemical feasibility work. P-04 is NOT prototype-ready. State remains TECHNICALLY_SPECIFIED with a clear path forward: a medicinal chemistry / enzyme engineering program is required to unblock the 4 BLOCKED items.
what_unfreezes_P-04: A 6-12 month enzyme engineering program (literature + in vitro testing of candidate enzymes in synthetic CSF) would unblock items 1-4. This is biology work, not software work — Article XXXIV applies. We cannot code our way past it.
next_action: Either (a) engage a collaborator with enzyme engineering capability (academic lab or CRO), or (b) descope P-04 to a single-enzyme version where one of neprilysin/BACE2/tau-kinase-inhibitor is selected and the others are dropped. Single-enzyme P-04 is prototype-ready in 3-6 months; triple-enzyme P-04 is 12-18 months.
